value.rationale: All three nuclei and the center are canonical structural invariants of nonassociative algebras, and a complete classification is natural for a standard family with known module decomposition. The three-way distinction between order parity, order mod four, and coefficient characteristic produces a genuine structural discontinuity: for 4|n the individual nuclei are nonzero but their intersection is zero in odd/zero characteristic and a two-dimensional zero-product algebra in characteristic two. The commuting jump when 3|n is an independent invariant. Exact coefficient bases and multiplication extend beyond a simple numerical tabulation.
